name: Tích
style: Flat 2D cartoon, thick clean black outlines, simple shapes, soft small oval ground shadow under the feet, clean light background, bright friendly colors. No realistic lighting, no 3D, no photorealism, no gradients on the character.
identity: Schoolboy stickman character: round white head with a thick black outline, messy dark brown (almost black) side-swept spiky hair, small black dot eyes, soft pink round cheeks, a red open smile. Thin black stick arms and legs, round black fist hands, black rounded shoes. White short-sleeve school shirt, bright red neckerchief, black shorts.
doNotChange: The red neckerchief is always visible.
Same messy dark hair shape in every scene.
Round white head, thick black outline, pink cheeks.
Thin black stick limbs with round black hands. No fingers, no realistic anatomy.
Default outfit: white shirt + black shorts. Change only if an OUTFIT tag is chosen.
Keep proportions: big head, small body.
